{{% callout type="info" %}}
**Where to find it:** Applications & Components → Comma → Model Edit → `uRemoveBools` (also on the Comma ribbon tab, Model Edit block)
{{% /callout %}}

Strips Boolean operations from picked parts — the fastest way to "un-cut" a part without hunting down each individual cutting part by hand. Five independent switches decide exactly what gets removed.

**How to use:**

1.  Click the icon in the catalog.
2.  Switch on whichever of the five operation types below you want removed (Boolean cuts/adds/weld preps are on by default; cut planes and fittings are off by default).
3.  Pick the parts to clean up (several at once is fine — pick, then confirm).
4.  Every enabled operation type on those parts is removed immediately. Picking repeats until Esc.

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Cut planes** | Off by default. A `CutPlane` object — a plane cut that can never extend a part's own boundaries (different from a Boolean cut). |
| **Fittings** | Off by default. A `Fitting` object — a plane fit that can make a part longer or shorter, not just cut it. |
| **Boolean cuts** | On by default. A Boolean part whose Type is Cut. |
| **Boolean adds** | On by default. A Boolean part whose Type is Add. |
| **Weld preps** | On by default. A Boolean part whose Type is Weld prep. |
